name: United Armenia
summary: United Armenia is the programme of uniting the Armenian lands divided between Ottoman and Russian rule into one independent democratic state. It rests on national self-determination, ancestral and ethnic claims to the territory, the return of exiles and diaspora, and guarantees from the Allied powers and the League of Nations. It is a territorial and national programme with little stated on the economy, society or most other questions.
scope: The 1918-1920 programme: the Armenian delegations' 1919 Peace Conference memorandum and the Act of United and Independent Armenia of 28 May 1919. It excludes later ARF socialist platforms, diaspora party disputes, ASALA tactics and present Armenian state policy.
